scientific_question: Can the dense Muon momentum and error-feedback states that make the procedural c_fc path functionally useful be represented within one procedural-coordinate budget per state family?

interpretation_contract.pass: Both state families pass with at least one optimistic explicit representation. This authorizes only a same-checkpoint functional replay using the selected compressed states.
interpretation_contract.fail: At least one required state family is dense-scale even under an oracle low-rank or index-free sparse representation. This closes naive explicit compact state, but not every nonlinear temporal coder.
interpretation_contract.accounting: The 405504-scalar allowance is granted separately to each state family. Sparse indices are deliberately ignored, so sparse recovery is an optimistic upper bound.
